audience: local engineering research report; publisher requirements not specified

worst_case_selection.rule: Largest finite RelativeError among NoiseUncertaintyOnly/QModelErrorOnly/CombinedUncertainty Split; includes finite solver-failed results; ties use declared branch order then IDs/seeds

figure_selection: First saved predesignated IDs/seeds for named suite/scenario; no score/appearance selection
missing_policy: Numeric summaries use finite values, including solver-failed finite scores; nonfinite counts explicit. Original NaN/N/A retained. No value replaced by zero.
replicate_policy: Descriptive observations nested within geology/calibration. No rowwise confidence intervals or significance claims.

figures.title: 逐模型波形误差 / Waveform error by model
figures.alt_text: Four panels compare every method for each model in Main and LowerSNR, separately for Direct and Split. Points are finite-row means, vertical lines span the empirical 10th–90th percentiles. Numerical failures with finite scores remain included; nonfinite counts are explicit.
transformations: Main/LowerSNR are displayed separately
Mean and empirical p10–p90 within each model; descriptive, not a confidence interval
No success-status filter; nonfinite values counted, never converted to zero

figures.title: 相对Frozen的全部配对差 / All paired changes versus Frozen
figures.alt_text: Individual paired percentage changes are shown as faint points and each model mean as a larger symbol. Zero means equality with the same-route Frozen. Every paired finite score is included, with unresolved counts disclosed.
transformations: Pairing uses Model/Suite/Scenario/Seed/CalibrationSeed/Route/SNRdB
100*(method error-Frozen error)/Frozen error; a zero reference denominator is unresolved
All finite paired rows retained, including failed-status rows

figures.title: Direct局部保幅代价 / Local amplitude costs (Direct)
figures.alt_text: Six panels display paired absolute changes in event amplitude, weak-event, pinchout-tail, AVO intercept, AVO gradient and fault-neighborhood errors. Small circles show model means, larger method symbols show the equal-model average. Missing and inapplicable entries are counted together and retained in source data.
transformations: Main and LowerSNR only; all finite applicable pairs
Absolute method-minus-Frozen metric difference
Small circles=model means; larger symbols=equal-model mean; no inferential intervals
NaN can mean metric inapplicable; no NaN is turned into zero

figures.title: 不隐藏失败 / Failures retained in the full denominator
figures.alt_text: Two stacked bar charts classify every row from every suite as numerical/invalid, a valid waveform error above one, or a valid error at most one. Numbers above bars give all-row denominators; nonfinite errors remain in the invalid category.
transformations: All suites included, with no removed rows
Numerical/invalid includes non-success Status, nonzero FinalFlag, nonfinite scores/residuals or normal residual>2e-7
Stacked fractions have a zero baseline and full all-row denominator

figures.title: 全部分布及完整最差尾部 / Full distributions including the worst tail
figures.alt_text: Empirical cumulative curves include every finite RelativeError, regardless of solver status, across all suites. Their denominator includes nonfinite rows, so an incomplete curve can end below one. The full observed error range is shown and the error=1 threshold is marked.
transformations: All suites and all finite scores; no status filter or tail clipping
ECDF denominator is all rows, including nonfinite
Pooled descriptive distribution; repeated noise rows are not independent geology
Mean/median/p90/p95/worst exported per model/suite/method/route

figures.title: 压力情景与最差案例 / Stress suites and worst cases
figures.alt_text: The left heatmap contains mean paired percentage changes for Combined Split versus Frozen Split in every stress suite and model, with symmetric full-range colors and gray missing cells. The right table names the worst finite error for every method across all rows and routes. Nonfinite failures are reported separately rather than omitted from the study.
transformations: Stress heatmap uses every paired finite stress row with no success-status filter
Heatmap limits are ±maximum absolute displayed change; missing=gray
Worst cases selected explicitly by maximum finite RelativeError, not appearance
